Title: Azure ExpressRoute is generally available in eight additional locations

Body.Content:
Azure ExpressRoute lets you extend your on-premises networks into the Microsoft cloud over a private connection facilitated by a connectivity provider. The ExpressRoute footprint is expanding to eight new locations:

  • Amsterdam2
  • Frankfurt
  • London2
  • Perth
  • Silicon Valley2
  • Taipei
  • Washington DC2
  • Zurich

For a full overview of available ExpressRoute locations, please visit the ExpressRoute partners and peering locations documentation page.
